approximations: MIN_TIME_BETWEEN_SAVES throttle not reconstructed (TimeSpan unit unproven).
Lua Save() errors or a missing _saveData fail the save; the original ignores the call error and could write a stale or Lua-less save.
Saves are written synchronously; the original uses SaveToDeviceAsync and a remote (cloud) device.
Checksums are always verified on load (the Load caller's verify flag was not recovered); legacy saves without the SGB1 magic are rejected.
Save files that exist but cannot be decoded are treated as absent when choosing between Profile1.sav and Profile1_Temp.sav.
Only the currently loadable map (RoomOpening) can be restored; other targets fail before Lua Load runs.
The SaveParams platform metadata and save-spinner UI are not reproduced.
